## TickLib.tickToPrice() function

Converts a Midnight tick into a WAD price.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function tickToPrice(tick: BigIntish): bigint;
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

</th><th>

<tbody><tr><td>

tick


</td><td>

[BigIntish](./morpho-ts.bigintish.md)


</td><td>

Tick in the deployed range.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

bigint

WAD price rounded to `PRICE_ROUNDING_STEP`<!-- -->.

## Exceptions

`NegativeValueError` when `tick` is negative.

`TickOutOfRangeError` when `tick` exceeds `MAX_TICK`<!-- -->.

## Example


```ts
import { TickLib } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const price = TickLib.tickToPrice(6744n);
console.log(price);
```
